integrity: Proof combines an infinite coordinate-splitting lemma with a finite exhaustive exact-type enumeration for dimensions 2 through 16; a second direct algorithm cross-checks dimensions 2 through 7. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to antipodal quotient graphs of binary cubes of dimensions at least two, in pure equality/adjacency first-order logic of quantifier rank four.
No claim about counting quantifiers, named coordinates, higher-rank types, or a smallest representative among all graphs.
Literature-priority search is bounded and cannot prove uniqueness.
title: Eight four-round theories of antipodally folded binary cubes
